title: Windows errno-only contention remediation + release rebind

defect.exception: PermissionError errno=13 during exclusive lock-file create with no usable winerror
defect.root_cause: Transient Windows lock contention was misclassified as a permanent permission failure when CPython exposed only errno=13.

changes.purpose: Bounded fallback for Windows errno-only EACCES contention while preserving fail-fast permission semantics.
Regression coverage for transient retry and persistent fail-fast behavior.
